title: ZXing does not work on Android 14
symptom: The scanner screen does not fully open on some phones sometimes when using the camera to scan, particularly on Android 14. The option to scan from a saved image works, but the camera option fails.
fix: Rotate the phone to landscape mode before attempting to scan, which makes the scan window open in the center of the screen. The problem was resolved as of the 2025.10.04 release.
evidence_quote: It turns out all you have to do is to rotate the phone to go into the landscape mode before attempting to scan. Then, the scan window opens in the center of the screen
